idx.title: 珠海观鸟图鉴 · %d 种华南常见鸟类图文与鸣声指南
idx.desc: 面向珠三角与珠海的常见鸟类观察手册：%d 种鸟的中文名、学名、辨识特征、习性、野外鸣声录音与观鸟地点，附四季观鸟日历与观鸟守则。
idx.eyebrow: Field Guide · Zhuhai & Pearl River Delta
idx.lede: 从淇澳岛的红树林到香山湖的荷塘，珠海处在东亚—澳大利西亚候鸟迁飞区的必经之路上。这份手册收录了 %d 种在本地有机会遇见的鸟——它们的样子、习性，以及声音。
idx.groups_blurb: 野外观鸟的第一步不是记住每一种鸟，而是判断它属于哪一类。五个类群，对应五种完全不同的生活方式。
idx.index_blurb: 按遇见概率从高到低排列，共 %d 种——从「几乎一定看得到」的极常见种，到「需要运气」的罕见种。点击任意一种查看辨识要点、习性、鸣声与在珠海的具体观察地点。
idx.empty: 没有匹配的物种，换个关键词试试。
idx.spots_blurb: 珠海的海岸线超过 600 公里，滩涂、红树林、水田与城市公园在很小的半径内并存——这意味着一个周末就能横跨三种完全不同的鸟类群落。以下六处是最容易上手的地点。

idx.title: Birds of Zhuhai · A Field Guide to %d Common Birds of South China
idx.desc: A field guide to the birds of Zhuhai and the Pearl River Delta: %d species with names, identification features, habits, field recordings and where to find them, plus a seasonal calendar and field ethics.
idx.eyebrow: Field Guide · Zhuhai & Pearl River Delta
idx.h1thin: A FIELD GUIDE TO SOUTH CHINA
idx.lede: From the mangroves of Qi'ao Island to the lotus ponds of Xiangshan Lake, Zhuhai sits squarely on the East Asian–Australasian Flyway. This guide covers %d birds you have a real chance of meeting here — how they look, how they live, and how they sound.
idx.groups_blurb: The first step in the field is not memorising every species but deciding which group a bird belongs to. Five groups, five entirely different ways of living.
idx.index_blurb: Sorted by likelihood of encounter, highest first — all %d species, from the ones you can almost guarantee to the ones that need luck. Open any species for identification notes, habits, voice, and the exact places to look in Zhuhai.
idx.empty: No species match. Try another word.
idx.spots_blurb: Zhuhai's coastline runs more than 600 km, and tidal flats, mangroves, paddies and city parks all sit within a short drive of one another — a single weekend can take you across three entirely different bird communities. These six sites are the easiest places to start.
